# JFrog

> > JFrog provides software supply chain solutions for DevOps and DevSecOps, featuring Artifactory for artifact management, security tools, and CI/CD pipelines.

JFrog is a DevOps platform company specializing in binary repository management, software distribution, and security scanning. Their flagship product Artifactory serves as a universal artifact repository manager, with additional tools for pipelines, security (Xray), and distribution.

## Key Topics

- JFrog Artifactory
- Artifact Management
- DevOps
- DevSecOps
- Software Supply Chain
- Binary Repository
- JFrog Pipelines
- JFrog Xray
- Distribution Edges
- Cleanup Policies
- Jenkins Integration
- CI/CD
- Package Management
- Security Scanning
